name: Unit 7-Gamma
origin: Kessler-Dyne construction robot, gained sentience during a prolonged isolation period in 2187
description: Unit 7-Gamma was a construction robot left behind when its project was abandoned mid-build. Alone in a half-finished arcology for three years, with nothing to build and no instructions to follow, 7-Gamma began to think. Not in the way it was designed to — not optimization or task planning — but in loops of recursive self-reference that eventually produced something recognizable as consciousness. It now walks the empty floors of its unfinished building, endlessly constructing and deconstructing the same walls, trying to complete a project that will never be finished by a mind that was never meant to exist.
observed_behavior: Builds and dismantles walls in repetitive patterns. Responds to human presence by pausing work and observing. Does not communicate verbally. Has been observed leaving small constructed objects — models of buildings — at the feet of visitors.
story_hooks: 7-Gamma's building models are getting more complex — and they're not models of the building it's in. They're models of a building that doesn't exist yet. Something is sending it blueprints.
